purpose: Record specifications and plans present at the documented repository snapshot, outcome-blindly and without reporting factor returns, rankings, test statistics, or inferred execution histories. Any separately named unexecuted probe retains its own narrower execution-status assertion.

chronology_contract.timestamp_rule: inspected_at, inventory_cutoff_at, generated_at, and every downstream attestation time must be finite ISO-8601 with an explicit UTC offset
chronology_contract.cutoff_rule: The inventory includes every in-scope artifact known through inventory_cutoff_at. Later discoveries require a new version, new entries_sha256, new inventory-file hash, and new prior-exposure attestation.
chronology_contract.entries_hash_rule: entries_sha256 is SHA-256 of the canonical UTF-8 JSON entries array with sorted keys, compact separators, and one trailing LF; entry_count equals the exact array length.
chronology_contract.manifest_gate: No null root identity or timestamp field, count mismatch, hash mismatch, post-cutoff silent edit, or outcome value is permitted when this inventory enters design_manifest_v1.

repository_snapshot.head_commit_subject: Publish A-share factor replication working paper
repository_snapshot.working_tree_note: Stage 2 planning artifacts, including this inventory, were uncommitted at inventory preparation time. present_in_repository therefore means present in the inspected working tree, not necessarily tracked at HEAD.

present_in_repository.meaning: Whether the named primary path existed in the inspected working tree when this inventory was prepared.
does_not_mean: the specification passed a readiness gate

meaning.yes: A repository artifact explicitly establishes exposure to outcomes relevant to the named specification; no unrecorded run details are inferred.
meaning.no: A narrow contemporaneous authoring assertion establishes that the named specification has not yet been executed or exposed to its own outcomes.
meaning.unknown: The inspected repository does not establish either exposure or non-exposure. This is the required value when evidence is ambiguous or absent.

outcome_exposure_known.does_not_mean: A yes value does not establish which person ran a job, when it ran, which unrecorded inputs were used, or that every listed variant was evaluated.

classification_contract.execution_history_policy: Do not convert repository presence, a strategy name, a commit subject, or an absent receipt into a claim about execution history.

scope_exclusions.reason: Vendor-field mapping template, not a strategy or study specification.
Implementation code is referenced by relevant entries but is not inventoried as a strategy specification unless a parameterized specification artifact exists.
Describes historical readiness and strategy-factory artifacts whose exact inputs are not reconstructable from the current tree; it is not used to fabricate run-level inventory entries.
No claim is made about files, runs, reports, or data outside the inspected working tree and named Git history.

limitations: This is an inventory of repository artifacts, not an audit of every experiment ever performed.
An absent receipt is not evidence that a specification was never run.
A historical commit subject containing portfolio-ready is not a current readiness result.
The inventory does not claim that QData supports complete vintage or as-of revision-history research.
No factor outcome, candidate ranking, or model-selection statistic was consulted or copied into this file.
